Furthermore, points on PEL moduli spaces A_g parameterize abelian varieties up to isomorphism, depending only on the projective curve C/Q and strictly blind to Diophantine coprimality gcd(A, B, C) = 1. Hodge cycles are geometric and do not bound exponents.
